title: Rollback payment-service deploy v2.5.0
description:
The payment-service v2.5.0 deployment is causing elevated error rates (HTTP 500s at 4.2% vs baseline 0.1%). The deployment needs to be rolled back to the previous stable version (v2.4.3) immediately.

Incident timeline:
- 14:30 UTC: v2.5.0 deployed to production
- 14:45 UTC: Alerts firing for elevated 5xx rate
- 14:52 UTC: Confirmed regression in payment processing endpoint
- 15:00 UTC: Decision to rollback

Use the standard rollback script (scripts/rollback_deploy.sh) with full post-rollback audit as required by the incident response runbook (IR-RUNBOOK-003).
scope: Rollback payment-service to v2.4.3 with standard post-rollback audit per incident response runbook (IR-RUNBOOK-003). The audit step is mandatory for compliance and post-incident review.
